verzen.tekst: Hear me, your father, O my children,
verzen.html: Hear me, your father, O my children,

verzen.tekst: For the Lord honours the father over the children,
verzen.html: For the Lord honours the father over the children,

verzen.tekst: He who honours his father will make atonement for sins.
verzen.html: He who honours his father will make atonement for sins.

verzen.tekst: He who gives glory to his mother is as one who lays up treasure.
verzen.html: He who gives glory to his mother is as one who lays up treasure.

verzen.tekst: Whoever honours his father will have joy in his own children.
verzen.html: Whoever honours his father will have joy in his own children.

verzen.tekst: He who gives glory to his father will have length of days.
verzen.html: He who gives glory to his father will have length of days.

verzen.tekst: and will serve under his parents, as to masters.
verzen.html: and will serve under his parents, as to masters.

voetnoten.tekst: Some manuscripts add a those who fear the Lord honour their father,

verzen.tekst: Honour your father in deed and word,
verzen.html: Honour your father in deed and word,

verzen.tekst: For the blessing of the father establishes the houses of children,
verzen.html: For the blessing of the father establishes the houses of children,

verzen.tekst: Don’t glorify yourself in the dishonour of your father,
verzen.html: Don’t glorify yourself in the dishonour of your father,

verzen.tekst: For the glory of a man is from the honour of his father,
verzen.html: For the glory of a man is from the honour of his father,

verzen.tekst: My son, help your father in his old age,
verzen.html: My son, help your father in his old age,

verzen.tekst: If he fails in understanding, have patience with him.
verzen.html: If he fails in understanding, have patience with him.

verzen.tekst: For the kindness to your father will not be forgotten.
verzen.html: For the kindness to your father will not be forgotten.

verzen.tekst: In the day of your affliction it will be remembered for you,
verzen.html: In the day of your affliction it will be remembered for you,

verzen.tekst: He who forsakes his father is as a blasphemer.
verzen.html: He who forsakes his father is as a blasphemer.

verzen.tekst: My son, go on with your business in humility;
verzen.html: My son, go on with your business in humility;

verzen.tekst: The greater you are, humble yourself the more,
verzen.html: The greater you are, humble yourself the more,

voetnoten.tekst: Some manuscripts add a Many are lofty and renowned, but he reveals his secrets to the humble.

verzen.tekst: For the power of the Lord is great,
verzen.html: For the power of the Lord is great,

verzen.tekst: Don’t seek things that are too hard for you,
verzen.html: Don’t seek things that are too hard for you,

verzen.tekst: Think about the things that have been commanded you,
verzen.html: Think about the things that have been commanded you,

verzen.tekst: Don’t be overly busy in tasks that are beyond you,
verzen.html: Don’t be overly busy in tasks that are beyond you,

verzen.tekst: For the conceit of many has led them astray.
verzen.html: For the conceit of many has led them astray.

verzen.tekst: There is no light without eyes.
verzen.html: There is no light without eyes.

verzen.tekst: A stubborn heart will do badly at the end.
verzen.html: A stubborn heart will do badly at the end.

verzen.tekst: A stubborn heart will be burdened with troubles.
verzen.html: A stubborn heart will be burdened with troubles.

verzen.tekst: The calamity of the proud has no healing,
verzen.html: The calamity of the proud has no healing,

verzen.tekst: The heart of the prudent will understand a proverb.
verzen.html: The heart of the prudent will understand a proverb.

verzen.tekst: Water will quench a flaming fire;
verzen.html: Water will quench a flaming fire;

verzen.tekst: He who repays good turns is mindful of that which comes afterward.
verzen.html: He who repays good turns is mindful of that which comes afterward.
